findings.description: On the cart page the Checkout button is pulled out of the layout and pinned at the very top of the page, overlapping the header (on a 360 px phone it covers the 'Swag Labs' title and the cart icon) instead of sitting below the cart items next to Continue Shopping. The button carries a class 'btn_visual_failure'.
repro: Add any product to the cart
Open the cart at 1280 px or 360 px width
Observe Checkout button at top of viewport over the header

findings.description: The button of the last product (Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt, long two-line name) overflows its card. On desktop it sticks out past the right edge of the card; on a 360 px phone it is wider than the other buttons, extends past the card to the viewport edge and is displaced above the price, unlike the other cards.
repro: Open /inventory.html at 1280 px and at 360 px
Compare the last product's Add to cart button with the other cards

findings.description: The cart icon is not aligned in the header: on desktop it floats at about x=1050 (not at the right edge) overlapping the sort dropdown area, and on a 360 px phone it sits under the 'Swag Labs' title, overlapping it. Same on all pages.
repro: View any page at 1280 px and 360 px width

findings.description: On the 360 px layout the inventory list is extremely tall (about 5000 px) with large empty gaps between description and price, and the price/button order differs between cards. Also, product names on desktop are inconsistently aligned (Bolt T-Shirt and Fleece Jacket are indented/centred while others are left-aligned).

Product prices change on every load of the inventory page (e.g. Backpack $25.21, $67, $85.97) and do not match the price in the product detail page and cart ($29.99). Prices also lose trailing zeros ($85.2, $44.6, $45.3).
repro: Note prices on /inventory.html, reload and compare
Open Backpack detail and cart and compare price

findings.description: Keyboard focus is not visible anywhere: focused links, buttons, and the sort select all have outline-style none and no box-shadow, so keyboard users cannot see where focus is.
repro: No focus ring appears on sort select, product links or Add to cart buttons

notes: Did not fully test sort, logout, About, Dynamic Catalog menu pages or checkout error validation messages; time-limited.

cost.notes: estimate from 34267 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0069-$0.0822
